decision: NO_GO to describe these17 as known-error correction examples atS5. A separate early-path-intervention feasibility question is logically possible but not executed or authorized by this review.
supports_fixed_S5_question: S5/task/source/seed/full ordered map and original continuation are already frozen; all17 reach an eligible S5, so a later separately authorized one-shot intervention could measure currently unknownYT without outcome-dependent new prefix selection.
Full17 failure-conditioned denominator could give a finite development result for this exact intervention, including invalid/no-action outcomes; not an estimate of broad task-success gains.
opposes_error_repair_or_learning_claim: 13 action6 records are compatible with normal task progress/search; four have only ambiguous redundancy. No action6 is established as an actual causal error.

Two cases place their first goal object at action6; other two-object cases retrieve/carry/open a goal container at this boundary. Altering such an action is a path perturbation, not certified error repair.
Nine long period<=10 cycles and an additional verified longer C088 recurrence occur later; hindsight failure cannot label the early action wrong or provide a correct target.
Even a successful early intervention would not establish a learnable first-action correction, student transfer, a nondegenerate same-pool B/C selection contrast or sufficient training dose.
new_information_relative_to_R19: A future fixedS5 experiment would only add conditional evidence about this new17-case frozen early-checkpoint recipe and unknownYT. R19 already contains real recovery successes/harms; another rescue alone is not novel evidence that self-improvement learning works. A more explicit selected-mechanism diagnostic must be separately named and cannot alter oldSI-S01 NO_GO.
